essays.question: Explain Activity-Based Costing (ABC), its advantages, limitations and situations where it is useful.
answer_points: ABC assigns overhead costs based on activities that consume resources.
Assign costs based on actual resource usage.
Useful for companies with high overhead and diverse products.

essays.question: Explain the purpose of budgeting and describe different types of budgets used by organizations.
answer_points: Budgeting helps planning and controlling operations.
Operating budget includes sales, production and expense budgets.
Flexible budgets adjust according to activity levels.

essays.question: Explain responsibility centers and performance measurement techniques.
answer_points: Responsibility centers assign accountability to managers.
Profit centers manage revenue and expenses.
Investment centers manage assets and returns.
Common measures include ROI and residual income.
